_comment: The older PUCT config: 192 simulations a move, no Gumbel. Kept for reference and for a from-scratch PUCT run. It does NOT continue runs/az_15gb - that run has been Gumbel since generation 1, and resuming it here would mix two kinds of search in one replay buffer. The GPU config train.py actually uses is colab_az_gumbel.json.
_gate_threshold: 40 games at 0.55 needs 22/40, which an evenly-matched candidate reaches 31.8% of the time - and two candidates are gated (live and ema) with the better one taken, so ~53% of gates promoted noise. 64 games at 0.60 needs 39/64: 5.2% false per candidate, ~10% for the pair, while still catching a genuinely 65%-strong net 79% of the time.
_gate_every: Was every 5 iterations, so the gate ran 100 times over a 500-iteration run - at ~53% false promotion each, best.pt was reduced to a random walk. Every 20 keeps 25 gates and the same wall-clock share as before with 1.6x the games each.
